name: agent-activity
description: The agent's live activity as rows the desktop renders in the room (events drawer) and the dock (Agent activity panel). Hooks produce the Working and Thinking rows; nothing depends on the agent remembering. Config: AGENT_DISPLAY_NAME names the agent in the first row (env override > this manifest > 'Your agent'). LEDGER_STEP_PUBLISH_ENABLED defaults off; the gateway publisher uses room.task.progress when deployed. SUTANDO_STOP_INTERRUPT=1 lets a Stop send one Escape to the core's turn when that turn is on the stopped task alone, and marks the task cancelled only once the stop is ruled; off (default), a cancel marks the task cancelled at once. PHASE_MODEL (off|vertex, default off) refines the phase word and writes a status line with Gemini on PHASE_MODEL_PROJECT; the only network use, and only when on (scripts/phase_line.py).
